text:
Image A is a 1280×720 graphic with a pale blue-gray background and a large white rounded-corner card centered on it. On the card:

- **Title:** "Visual Transport Check" in bold dark navy lettering, upper-left of the card.
- **Three shapes in a row:** a red/crimson circle on the left, a blue square in the middle, and a green triangle (pointing up) on the right, roughly aligned horizontally.
- **Caption:** "Marker: K7M4" in smaller dark text at the lower-left of the card.
- No borders, shadows, or other graphics; the lower part of the frame is empty.

Now let me look at image B.

Both files are visible, so the sequential observation is complete.

## Image B — visible elements
A 1280×720 dashboard-style layout with no rounded corners or card framing:

- **Header band:** a full-width burnt-orange rectangle spanning the top ~160 px. It holds the white bold title **"Field Notes"** and, beneath it, the smaller white subtitle **"Weekly project overview"**.
- **Left column:** a stack of three pale yellow panels, each separated by thin white gaps:
  1. **"Active projects"** — large number **12**, with caption "Across all teams".
  2. **"Tasks completed"** — large number **84**, with caption "This week".
  3. **"Team members"** — large number **24**, with caption "Working together" (the panel runs to the bottom edge).
- **Right side:** a large empty white area with nothing on it, roughly two-thirds of the width.

## Comparison A vs B
- **Purpose/content:** A is a minimal logo-like test card (title, three geometric shapes, a code marker); B is an informational text dashboard (title, subtitle, three numeric statistics).
- **Palette:** A is light: pale blue-gray background, white card, navy text, red/blue/green shapes. B is heavily warm: orange header, yellow stats, black text, plain white remainder.
- **Layout:** A centers a single rounded white card in the frame and leaves the bottom empty. B is edge-to-edge: an orange header bar plus a left-column stack of yellow tile-like panels, with a large white void on the right.
- **Typography:** both use a clean sans-serif. A uses dark navy bold heading text; B uses white bold headings on orange and black headings/figures on yellow.
- **Shared traits:** same 1280×720 dimensions, flat design with no shadows or gradients, and plain sans-serif body text with no images, charts, or icons.
- **Not shared:** shapes, numbers (A has only the "K7M4" alphanumeric marker; B has the numbers 12, 84, 24), colors, and overall composition are all different. Neither file appears to be a variant of the other; they are two unrelated designs.
